task1.title: Visitors to Ashdown Museum and visitor satisfaction surveys
task1.prompt: The table below shows the numbers of visitors to Ashdown Museum during the year before and the year after it was refurbished. The charts show the results of surveys asking visitors how satisfied they were with their visit, during the same two periods.

visuals.caption: Total number of visitors to Ashdown Museum
Results of surveys of visitor satisfaction - Year before refurbishment
Results of surveys of visitor satisfaction - Year after refurbishment

chartDesc.overview: Following the refurbishment of Ashdown Museum, both total visitor numbers and overall visitor satisfaction increased significantly. The proportion of satisfied and very satisfied visitors rose markedly, while dissatisfaction dropped substantially.
keyFeatures: From the table, the total number of visitors increased from 74,000 in the year before refurbishment to 92,000 in the year after.
From the pie chart before refurbishment, the largest proportion of visitors was dissatisfied (40%), followed by satisfied (30%), very satisfied (15%), very dissatisfied (10%), and no response (5%).

From the pie chart after refurbishment, satisfied visitors became the largest group at 40%, while very satisfied increased to 35%, dissatisfied dropped to 15%, very dissatisfied dropped to 5%, and no response remained unchanged at 5%.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task2.title: Economic progress versus other types of progress
task2.prompt:
Many governments think that economic progress is their most important goal. Some people, however, think that other types of progress are equally important for a country.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
